findings.text: `hostname[-1]` raises IndexError when the URL has an empty netloc. Before this change, `URL('/path').replace(port=8000)` and `URL('/path').replace(username='u')` returned a URL, because `self.hostname` was None or empty. Now the netloc is '' so the host is '' and the index fails.

The host is now taken from the raw netloc instead of the lowercased `self.hostname`, so mixed-case hosts keep their case. For example, `URL('http://EXAMPLE.com/').replace(port=81)` now gives `http://EXAMPLE.com:81/`, where it used to give `example.com`. Code that compares or normalizes the host will see a different result.

1.reason: The patch does take the host from the raw netloc, so its original case is kept, but hostnames are case-insensitive and keeping the URL's own text (which also keeps IPv6 brackets) is the intended design, not a defect.
